column1: # Content-scan exemptions.
# Each row is  <sha256(path + ' ' + category)>  <expires YYYY-MM-DD>  <ticket>
# — no plaintext, so this file is safe in a public repo.
# An exemption suppresses findings for one path/category pair until its expiry date,
# then the scan FAILS. That is deliberate: these are deadlines, not opt-outs. To add
# one, run the scan, then:
#   node .github/scripts/hash-exemption.mjs <path> <category> <YYYY-MM-DD> <ticket>
# Why these four exist
# They hold identifiers that the backend defines. The values travel in query params,
# request bodies and list filters, and the UI matches them by substring — renaming
# them here alone silently breaks container detection, PDU layouts and settings
# lookup, with no type error to catch it. Clearing them needs a coordinated backend
# change.
# Everything reachable from the UI side has already been fixed: the identifiers that
# propagated these names through the rest of the codebase were renamed, the tests now
# reference the constants instead of hardcoding the strings, and the user-facing
# display labels were changed. What is left is four string values on the wire and
# nothing else.
